territories.name: Sierra Leone
territories.legal_reference: Directive 2006/112/EC, article 5(2): the common system of VAT applies in the territory of the Community as defined by the Treaties, and a State outside it is a third country for every rule the Directive carries. Sierra Leone levies a goods and services tax of its own under the Goods and Services Tax Act, 2009 (Act No. 6 of 2009), administered by the National Revenue Authority: section 14 imposes it on the taxable supply and the taxable import, at the single rate of 15 per cent, with a zero rate for the supplies of the First Schedule and exemption for those of the Second.
